justifications.read_only_justification: Returns UI navigation context and optionally checks access to an existing project; opening the view does not submit work.
justifications.open_world_justification: Opens the fixed first-party Shorty workspace and uses tenant-scoped identifiers.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool itself does not save edits, upload, delete, cancel or purchase.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the call only observes existing state or recovers the same canonical named project; it does not submit additional work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or reuses a project and uploads an immutable reference asset.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accepts user-supplied media URLs on arbitrary public hosts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds assets without deleting or replacing existing media.
justifications.idempotent_justification: No unconditional retry guarantee is advertised: this operation can create work, spend credits, or start a new attempt; some paths support backend deduplication or runKey.
